title: Today I’ve been reflecting on the cries for justice in Iran — where men and women are risking everything for dignity, freedom and a future without fear. My heart aches. In times like these, the Bible calls us to defend the weak and speak up for the oppressed (Proverbs 31:8-9). Let’s pray for peace, for truth to rise above fear, and for world leaders to choose mercy over might. And as we navigate an age of deepfakes and misinformation, let’s cling to the One who is the Truth (John 14:6). Our world needs discernment and compassion — not more division.
